name: Yewande Strömberg-Obi
description: Yewande Strömberg-Obi operates exclusively in the pirate mesh underground, producing neural-feed content that deliberately exploits undocumented vulnerabilities in licensed BCI hardware to deliver experiences that licensed production cannot legally replicate. Her work — distributed through dead drops and encrypted mesh nodes — has a waiting list measured in months. She is wanted by three corponation legal divisions simultaneously and has not been physically located in four years.
cultural_impact: She redefined what underground neural-feed production could be — not a degraded version of licensed work but a genuinely distinct form that licensed production cannot produce by design.
story_hooks: A dead drop containing her latest work also contains what appears to be a distress signal embedded in the file structure — she may have been found.
Vantablack has hired a team to locate her using the neural signature analysis from her own work; a player who has experienced her content may unknowingly carry traceable data.
She wants to surface briefly for a single production that requires physical presence in Meridian 88 — and needs a network of people to make that possible without being caught.
